title: Safety-mechanism RTL and VIP rotations
summary: Safety RTL implementation and waveform-based verification using virtual Arm IP and bus functional models.

dates.note: Assigned under the April 2020–April 2023 role in the supplied career outline. Exact individual rotation dates are unspecified.

facts.text: Designed safety-mechanism RTL for a lightweight non-coherent interconnect.
Worked with virtual Arm IP and bus functional models in large testbench simulations, using waveform viewers to debug Verilog testbenches, RTL designs and IP source code.
Initiated development on the Interconnect Architect desktop tool during the software engineering rotation period.
The safety-mechanism RTL rotation concerned the older internal interconnect Chariot.

notes: Do not infer exact rotation months, a public product mapping for Chariot, a numerical simulation size, waveform-viewer authorship, or authorship of later NoC GUI tooling from this rotation.
